overlap_details: No text, tick labels, title, or legend elements visibly overlap, collide, or clip.
issues: The normal (n=0) series is not visibly distinguishable from the thick black zero-reference line and may be occluded by it.
The uncertainty band is very light and somewhat difficult to inspect against the white background.
suggestions: Render the normal series above the zero-reference line, use a dashed or otherwise distinct style, or slightly offset the reference line to make it visible.
Increase the uncertainty-band opacity or use a subtly darker tint while retaining sufficient contrast.
Consider using a colorblind-safe blue/orange palette with slightly stronger contrast between the line and its uncertainty band.

issues: The baseline bar/error indication is nearly indistinguishable from the horizontal y=0 reference line because its value is zero.
The green bar is distinguishable, but a more standardized colorblind-safe palette could improve accessibility further.
suggestions: Use a subtle distinct marker or neutral fill for the baseline condition so its zero value is visually explicit.
Consider a tested colorblind-friendly palette such as Okabe-Ito while preserving the current blue/orange/green contrast.
